# Play — Factor Tree

- SudokuPad: [Factor Tree on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Factor Tree on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Little killers are native (`littlekillersum`, the same entries Rangsk's solver read when it confirmed uniqueness). Factor lines have no
f-puzzles entry, so each one is exported as a **cosmetic** red line (0.25 wide) and the app won't enforce it. The six branches share their
first cell with the trunk, so lines overlap at r2c5, r4c5 and r6c5. I have not opened the links in a browser myself. `grid.svg` in this
folder is the reference picture.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
